# Product requirements: ConvoScribe

An Android app for a **Qualcomm Dragonwing Q-6690** (QCS6690/QCM6690, Hexagon NPU) device — the
owner's test device is an Onyx Boox Tab (e-ink, build fingerprint `TabBoox:13`) —
that transcribes conversations **on-device, on the NPU**,
labels who spoke, and sends the transcript to a **remote OpenAI-compatible endpoint** for a summary
or for questions about the conversation.

## Goals

1. Live, on-device speech-to-text while recording. Two engines, **chosen by the user** in Settings
   (no automatic fallback): **NPU** (default) = Nemotron Speech Streaming EN 0.6B on the Hexagon NPU
   via sherpa-onnx's QNN backend, English only; **CPU** = Kroko streaming zipformer, English and French.
   An in-app Engine check verifies the NPU on the device.
2. After a recording stops, on-device speaker diarization labels each transcript line
   "Speaker 1", "Speaker 2", ...; the user can rename speakers.
3. Sessions (audio, transcript, speakers, summary, Q&A) persist across app restarts, in a list.
4. Summarise a session, or ask questions about it, through an OpenAI-compatible
   `/v1/chat/completions` endpoint, with answers streamed token by token.
5. v2 (last tasks): enroll known speakers by voice so they are named automatically.

package com.convoscribe.models

import java.io.File

/**
 * On-disk model store under `filesDir/models/<bundleId>/`.
 *
 * The downloader writes here, the recognizer/diarizer reads absolute
 * paths from here. We never trust an installed bundle without checking
 * every file exists and matches its declared [ModelFile.sizeBytes]: a
 * truncated download would otherwise produce a recognizer that fails
 * mid-session in a way that's hard to reproduce.
 */
class ModelStore(private val root: File) {

    /**
     * Directory that holds every file for [bundle]. Created lazily by
     * the downloader; this class does not create it.
     */
    fun bundleDir(bundle: ModelBundle): File = File(root, bundle.id)

    /**
     * Absolute path to a single file inside [bundle]'s directory.
     * `fileName` may contain a sub-directory (e.g. `test_wavs/0.wav`).
     */
    fun fileFor(bundle: ModelBundle, fileName: String): File = File(bundleDir(bundle), fileName)

    /**
     * True iff every file declared in [bundle] is present on disk and
     * has exactly the expected [ModelFile.sizeBytes]. A zero-byte file
     * (interrupted download) is *not* considered installed.
     */
    fun isInstalled(bundle: ModelBundle): Boolean = bundle.files.all { file ->
        val onDisk = fileFor(bundle, file.fileName)
        onDisk.exists() && onDisk.length() == file.sizeBytes
    }

    /**
     * Bundles in [bundles] that are not fully installed, in input order.
     * The downloader uses this to decide what to fetch.
     */
    fun missing(bundles: List<ModelBundle>): List<ModelBundle> = bundles.filterNot(::isInstalled)

    /**
     * Remove every file of [bundle] from disk. Missing bundles are a
     * no-op. Used by the Settings screen to free space.
     */
    fun delete(bundle: ModelBundle) {
        val dir = bundleDir(bundle)
        if (dir.exists()) {
            dir.deleteRecursively()
        }
    }
}

class AppContainer(val context: Context) {

    /**
     * Where downloaded models live: `filesDir/models/<bundleId>/...`.
     * Constructed at startup so the downloader, recognizer and
     * diarizer all read paths from the same place.
     */

     * Shared OkHttp client for the model downloader (and, later, the
     * LLM streaming client). Long read timeout because some model
     * downloads take minutes on slow networks; the 15 s connect timeout
     * still surfaces a dead server quickly.
     */
    val httpClient: OkHttpClient = OkHttpClient.Builder()
        .connectTimeout(15, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
        .readTimeout(120, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
        .build()

    /**
     * Downloads the model bundles the user picked in Settings. Bound
     * to [modelStore] so the files land in the same directory the
     * recognizer and diarizer read from.
     */
    val modelDownloader = ModelDownloader(httpClient, modelStore)
}
